metadata.audit_phase: Phase 4 - Observability, Monitoring and Distributed Tracing
metadata.audit_task: Final Read-Only Output Validation of Curriculum Agent and Mentor Agent

curriculum_agent_validation.classification_justification: The model output successfully passed Pydantic validation (CurriculumPlanModel), grounded itself in the official SQLite NCERT corpus (Chapter 1 Real Numbers), and generated rigorous objectives, activities, and checkpoints with the 70% threshold. However, it generated 3 distinct pedagogical stages rather than 7 explicitly labelled daily study units (Day 1 - Day 7), conforming to the prompt and schema defined in backend/agents/curriculum.py.

learning_stages.focus_topic: Euclid's Division Lemma and Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
HCF and LCM by prime factorization

mentor_agent_validation.classification_justification: The model output parsed and validated cleanly as structured JSON, accurately diagnosed all 4 student difficulties in Chemical Reactions and Equations, cited genuine NCERT textbook sections (1.1, 1.2, 1.3), provided active recall quizzes, and formulated a clear next milestone. However, the 4 recommendations sum to 65 minutes, slightly exceeding the requested 60-minute daily study budget by 5 minutes (+8.3% variance).

recommendations.title: Identify Types of Chemical Reactions
recommendations.action: Read NCERT Science Chapter 1, Section 1.1 (Types of Chemical Reactions) in detail.

recommendations.title: Practice Balancing Chemical Equations
recommendations.action: Complete the 5-question active recall quiz provided in your NCERT textbook for Chapter 1, Section 1.2.

recommendations.title: Study Oxidation and Reduction
recommendations.action: Read NCERT Science Chapter 1, Section 1.3 (Oxidation and Reduction) in detail.

recommendations.title: Recall Reaction Examples
recommendations.action: Create a 5-minute revision quiz for yourself, focusing on reaction examples from Chapter 1, Section 1.2.

learning_difficulties_identified: Identifying different types of chemical reactions

phase_4_recommendation.rationale: Phase 4 Observability, Monitoring, Callbacks, and Distributed Tracing objectives are fully achieved and verified. All eight canonical CrewAI agents have documented live execution evidence with local neural inference (qwen2.5:3b). The minor limitations in Curriculum Agent (3 stages instead of 7 labelled days) and Mentor Agent (65 mins instead of 60 mins) are prompt engineering and schema formatting nuances rather than observability or infrastructure failures. Phase 4 can be safely approved, and prompt calibrations can be incorporated as optional improvements in Phase 5.
